model_annotation: The scientific line graph is presented in the form of a heatmap, titled "Figure 4: 不同正负例阈值组合在CCKS-IMLTC数据上的实验结果" (Figure 4: Experimental results on CCKS-IMLTC data with different positive and negative threshold combinations). The graph displays the F1 values of the TextCNN-CB model on the CCKS-IMLTC dataset for various combinations of positive and negative example thresholds in the PST framework. The x-axis represents the negative example threshold, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 in increments of 0.1, while the y-axis represents the positive example threshold, ranging from 0.5 to 0.9 in the same increments. The F1 values are color-coded, with darker shades of blue indicating higher values and lighter shades indicating lower values. The heatmap shows that the highest F1 value of 76.237 is achieved when the positive example threshold is 0.7 and the negative example threshold is 0.4.
